name: mirage
text: v1.0.22 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.22 . Kalshi fixes: (1) the slip's Bet button now removes the row at the tap and keeps it off after rescans (it only comes back after 15 s if no order was recorded); (2) Kalshi bids sized at half a contract or more round to 1 contract instead of failing 'under one contract'; (3) the GitHub engine's Kalshi scan now publishes its list and the phone reads that instead of scanning Kalshi itself, so the screen shouldn't lag (falls back to the phone's scan if the engine list is over 10 min old). Kalshi arbitrage still uses a phone scan. Auto-bet shows 0 because 9338 of 9358 games start over 6 h out (trap guard); not changed yet.
